status: prospective policies; lane manifests bind final inputs before model admission
question: When does semantic interpretation improve record association beyond capable conventional representations and unlabeled Fellegi-Sunter EM?

products.identity: Publisher supplied many-to-many product mapping; unmatched means absent from that complete benchmark mapping.
paid_arms: recordwise text extraction plus fresh unlabeled Splink

images.primary: ABO grocery native main-image to catalog association
images.identity: Publisher item association, not independently verified physical SKU identity.
paid_arms: OCR-text extraction plus fresh unlabeled Splink
pixel extraction plus fresh unlabeled Splink
images.secondary_nil_population: Designed missing-counterpart stress; prevalence is constructed.

organizations.identity: Published affiliation annotation, not legal-unit identity.

estimation.em: Transductive on each declared unlabeled split; comparison specification and finite fitting policy frozen before outcome inspection.
estimation.u: Unlabeled random pairs from the same complete pair universe as the prior.
estimation.candidate_construction: Only observed fields; never insert gold targets.
estimation.lexical_rule: Lane-specific fixed rule saved before outcomes.
estimation.cardinality: Preserve each source relation; no forced one-to-one assignment.
estimation.organization_operating_rule_override: CORDIS primary uses top posterior>=0.99 with second<0.5, NIL when top<0.1; .5/.9/.99/.999 descriptive grid. See organizations/protocol.json.
estimation.image_operating_rule_override: See images/protocol.json: closed-catalog top1 rules and designed-NIL rules differ; Splink threshold .95 applies where declared by the lane, not the product .9 default.

models.model_weights: Hosted model aliases; returned model identifiers and date are recorded. Training-data exposure is unknown.

value_gate.scope: Development spending decision only; not a production acceptance or statistical power rule.
value_gate.reference: Fixed conventional method with highest complete development decision count; alphabetic method-name tie break.
value_gate.failure: Retain and report development outcomes; stop the unchanged paid lane/arm. Do not tune and retest the same holdout.
value_gate.attribution_pair: The image pixel and OCR-text arms are evaluated as a pair; if either passes, both unchanged arms may continue as the necessary modality control, subject to complete-batch admission.
value_gate.forced_ranking_diagnostics: Excluded from the gate unless a lane explicitly declares a closed-catalog top1 decision task. Image closed-catalog top1 is an operational rule. CORDIS forced top1 is diagnostic and excluded.
value_gate.image_development: 80 prospectively hash-selected queries against the96-record development catalog; baseline and semantic fits/scoring use identical80 queries. Exact IDs in contracts/image-development-subset.json.

scoring.primary: Exact target-set correctness on the complete frozen query denominator.
scoring.abstention: Review and failed are never correct identity or NIL decisions.
scoring.multiple_arms: Report all prespecified comparisons; intervals are descriptive, with no best-test-threshold selection.

budget.unit: Conservative token-price reservations, not billing invoices.
budget.admission: Complete immutable batch reserved before first request; unknown outcomes and failures retain full reservations.
budget.input_bound: UTF8 byte bound plus512 framing tokens; image high-detail maximum3000 tokens; input cache-write premium1.25; overall margin1.25.
budget.processing: Development uses synchronous Standard calls. Larger admitted evaluation runs use the Batch API at verified50-percent rates, with identical per-record requests; each whole evaluation manifest is reserved before submission. Batch submission may take up to24hours. No fallback to higher-priced synchronous service under a discounted reservation.

prospective_full_portfolio_preflight.interpretation: Unpaid preflight only; failed development gates still stop their planned evaluation arms.

synthetic_controls.truth: Immutable observed source record association; no LLM-generated gold or invented aliases.
synthetic_controls.sampling: Hash selection and transformation assignment fixed before performance outcomes.
synthetic_controls.layout: Paired deterministic source-fact documents and real OCR; untouched original retained.
synthetic_controls.independence: Views of the same source entity remain in one split and cluster; view count is not independent entity count.
synthetic_controls.claims: Mechanism controls, not representative NSO incidence.

completion_boundary: One complete test per admitted unchanged lane. Preserve negative results and failed source/value gates. Fresh questions need fresh outcome evidence; do not reopen a test to force a gain.
